variants.headline: Still in view: illness spreads beyond the clinics' reach
variants.sub: The pandemic has left {sick} people unable to work; {district} is the worst affected district.
variants.body:
Illness is spreading, with {sick} people too ill to work and {district} worst affected. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

The inability of clinics to treat people is central to the spread of illness. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
